user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server URL and API key. You can generate a long-lived API key in Immich under Settings > API Keys. Optionally choose a name (for example, Living Room) for this entry and its five entities.

album.title: Select Albums
album.description: Choose which albums to pull random images from. Leave all unchecked for a fully random image from your entire library. You can change this later in the integration settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Immich
reauth_confirm.description: Immich at {host} rejected the stored API key. Enter a new API key to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Immich server

abort.already_configured: This Immich instance is already configured

init.title: Immich Random Image Settings
init.description: Update your Immich connection settings and select which albums to pull random images from. Leave the API key field empty to keep your current key. Leave all albums unchecked for a fully random image from your entire library. A new image is pulled immediately when albums change.

data.scan_interval: Refresh interval (seconds, 0 for manual only, 60-300 recommended)
